learningObjectives: Plan a basic usability test around a specific user goal.
Identify usability problems from user behavior and feedback.
Prioritize findings based on their impact on task completion.

activities.title: Usability Test Flow
activities.instruction: Arrange the stages of a usability test.

content.concept: Usability testing involves defining goals, preparing tasks, observing users, collecting findings, and synthesizing results.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Test Task Builder
activities.instruction: Build a clear usability test task.

content.concept: A good usability task gives users a realistic goal without unnecessarily revealing the steps they should take.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Usability Problem Detector
activities.instruction: Identify the usability issue in each scenario.

content.concept: Usability problems can appear as confusion, errors, hesitation, inefficient paths, or inability to complete a task.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Finding Priority Lab
activities.instruction: Adjust impact and frequency to prioritize findings.

content.concept: Usability findings can be prioritized using factors such as severity, frequency, and impact on important user tasks.
